name: Yachimata (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yachimata city emblem in white: two stylised rounded characters side by side, like the numeral 33.
history: Municipal flag of Yachimata, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1964.

features.role: Yachimata city emblem — two stylised rounded characters side by side, like the numeral 33
